title: If You Feel Forgotten Tonight, Watch This
description:
You've done what was right, again and again, and it feels like nobody noticed. Maybe not even God. Joseph knew that feeling, in a pit, in a foreign land, in a prison where the one man who could help him forgot.

This is for anyone in a waiting season. You are not forgotten.

Key Scriptures: Genesis 40:23, Isaiah 49:15, Genesis 50:20, Psalm 34:18.

Lord, when I feel forgotten, remind me that you never forget me. Amen.

scenes.narration: It's late. The house is quiet... and the thing you've been carrying all day is still there.
scenes.visual_prompt: Rain running down a dark window, city lights blurred behind it, very slow push in

scenes.narration: You've done what was right. Again and again. And it feels like nobody noticed.
scenes.heading: Not Forgotten
scenes.visual_prompt: A lone figure at a kitchen table in the dark, one lamp, stillness

scenes.narration: Maybe you've stopped saying it out loud. But the question is still there. Where are you, God?
scenes.visual_prompt: An empty road disappearing into fog, camera drifting forward

scenes.narration: Joseph knew that question. Thrown into a pit by his own brothers. Sold to strangers. Carried to a land where no one knew his name.
scenes.visual_prompt: A caravan crossing desert dunes at dusk, long shadows, wide

scenes.narration: Then a prison cell. He helped a man there, and asked only one thing. Remember me. The Bible says it plainly. Yet the chief cup bearer didn't remember Joseph, but forgot him.
scenes.text: Yet the chief cup bearer didn't remember Joseph, but forgot him.
scenes.author: Genesis 40:23
scenes.visual_prompt: Dim stone cell, a single shaft of light on a young man's hands

scenes.narration: Two more years... in the dark. But people forgetting Joseph was never the same as God forgetting him.
scenes.text: People forgot him. God never did.
scenes.visual_prompt: Light breaking through heavy clouds over dark hills, slow tilt up

scenes.narration: And God is saying the same thing to you tonight. Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
scenes.text: Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
scenes.author: Isaiah 49:15
scenes.visual_prompt: Sun rays streaming through a misty forest, camera rising slowly

scenes.narration: The prison was not the end of Joseph's story. One day, everything changed. And your waiting is not wasted either.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sunrise spilling over a mountain ridge, golden light filling the valley

scenes.narration: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart. Near to you. Right now.
scenes.text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
scenes.author: Psalm 34:18
scenes.visual_prompt: A wheat field glowing in first light, wind moving through it

scenes.narration: So lift your head. Pray with me. Lord, when I feel forgotten, remind me that you never forget me. Give me strength for the next step. Amen.
scenes.visual_prompt: A figure walking up a hill toward the rising sun, wide and steady

scenes.narration: You are not forgotten. You are not alone. And your story isn't over.
scenes.visual_prompt: A simple wooden cross on a hilltop against a bright sky, slow push in
